name: @sand/worktrees
description: Git worktrees for threads: start a thread in a worktree, move a thread into one, name its branch after the thread, set it up, and clean it up after its PR merges

sand.label: Worktrees
sand.summary: Threads in their own git worktree

uses.server: the page cannot list, create, move or remove worktrees
uses.composer: no Local or worktree choice in the composer and no setup progress above it
uses.commands: no /worktree command, so the thread menu has no Move to worktree item
uses.transcript: removed worktrees show no note with a Restore button in the thread
uses.pulls: worktrees are not removed by themselves after their PR is merged
uses.notify: failed worktree actions are not reported
